benchmark.scope: the same public admissions at a later committed state: envelope reused versus rebuilt from the same preparing state every call; state guards and the exact gate run in both; evolutions excluded; no cache, log or parallel worker; not a simulation or world speed-up

case.scope: exact conservative motion-error admission for a declared future window of the accepted material-following finite-strain strip under a positive constant extension force: width, thickness and overburden change, raw plastic history only grows above a prepared floor and temperatures may evolve anywhere inside the accepted window; represented Gauss-point model only; not the continuous depth model, the fully coupled thermal trajectory, rupture, separation, an automatic solver switch, I02 transactions or world assembly

provenance.physics: the accepted cases/i01_finite_strain_v1.json, unchanged: its layered strip and its homogeneous wet-quartzite fixture, weakening law, drive 2e13 N/m, generalised drag 5e22 Pa s, reference width 1e5 m, stretch window [0.6, 1.4], temperature window [273, 1613] K, zero pore pressure and 1e14 s duration from the reference geometry
provenance.gate: the retained exact exponent-1 window gate of check_i01_decoupling through the retained column-admission helpers; the envelope is new, the gate is not
provenance.tolerances: 0.01 is the retained column-admission allowance and is always evaluated; 0.1 is an authored coarse allowance declared before execution so that one certified weak-belt window exists; neither is fitted, and the layered strip is expected to stay uncertified at both
provenance.analytic: the envelope formula for the retained column-admission analytical rate-linear layer and the accepted homogeneous layer, both at Gauss order 2 whose widths are exactly h/2, evaluated at an authored stretch and history floor (formula inputs, not states); the exact threshold is admitted from the rate-linear layer's own issued reference state over the authored duration
provenance.authored: committed sampling steps, displacement limit, numerical allowance, benchmark counts and the analytic stretch, history and duration are authored control inputs frozen before any run; the numerical allowance equals the retained column-admission inequality allowance
